title: Septodont and Adin Implants partner to advance implant dentistry in France
html:
Adin Dental Implant Systems

Fri. 20. November 2026

share save

SAINT-MAUR-DES-FOSSÉS, France: Septodont, a global provider of dental pharmaceuticals and solutions for dental professionals, and Adin Implants, a global dental implant company, have announced a long-term strategic partnership to expand implant dentistry in France.

The partnership combines Septodont’s established distribution network, commercial infrastructure and strong relationships with French dental professionals with Adin’s global expertise in implant dentistry and comprehensive implant, prosthetic and digital solutions. Under the agreement, Septodont will become the exclusive distributor of Adin’s implant solutions in France. The company will establish a dedicated implant business unit to provide specialised commercial and clinical support to dental professionals across the country.

For Septodont, the partnership represents an expansion of its surgical portfolio, adding comprehensive implant and restorative solutions to its existing offering. For Adin, with 25 years of experience, a presence in more than 80 countries and more than two million implants manufactured annually, France represents an important strategic market and another step in its long-term international growth strategy through partnerships with leading organisations. Adin will support the development of the French market through its global implant expertise, clinical education capabilities and commercial resources.

The companies will jointly showcase their implant solutions at the Congrès de l’ADF in Paris from 25 to 28 November. Further information is available at
